install_steps: Or: download a release tarball (includes rqlited node binary + rqlite CLI) from https://github.com/rqlite/rqlite/releases
note: rqlite is the client CLI; rqlited runs the database nodes. Connect with -H host -p port (default localhost:4001). In the shell use .tables/.schema/.status/.backup; for scripts use -e "SQL" to run and exit.
